name: Chalkboard
look: Dark classroom board with hand-drawn chalk lines, diagrams and writing.
motionRules: Draw-on strokes, handwritten reveals, gentle board dust; keep camera movement restrained.
promptTemplate: A clean educational chalkboard scene on a deep green-black board, hand-drawn white chalk illustration, sparse warm accent chalk, tactile dust and erased marks, editorial composition, no generated text unless explicitly requested.

name: Neon Night
look: Deep purple night scenes with luminous neon edges and high-contrast glow.
motionRules: Glow pulses, light sweeps and smooth edge traces; avoid frantic camera motion.
promptTemplate: Cinematic neon-night editorial illustration, deep purple-black environment, cyan and magenta luminous rim light, crisp silhouettes, glossy reflections, premium high contrast, no text or watermark.

name: Comic Panel
look: Bold comic frames, speech-bubble shapes and printed halftone texture.
motionRules: Panel wipes, snap zooms and punchy stepped entrances with brief impact holds.
promptTemplate: Graphic comic-book panel illustration, heavy ink contours, energetic framing, halftone dots, limited red yellow black palette, dramatic action composition, blank speech shapes only, no generated words.

name: Clay World
look: Soft tactile clay figures and miniature handcrafted sets.
motionRules: Soft spring entrances, subtle squash and stretch, miniature stop-motion cadence.
promptTemplate: Handmade claymation miniature scene, softly sculpted characters and props, visible fingerprints, warm studio lighting, shallow depth of field, friendly premium stop-motion aesthetic, no text.

name: Watercolor
look: Layered painted scenes on textured paper with soft pigment blooms.
motionRules: Slow dissolves, drifting paper layers and gentle Ken Burns movement.
promptTemplate: Expressive editorial watercolor painting on cold-press paper, translucent layered washes, visible pigment blooms and paper tooth, restrained blue coral palette, airy negative space, no text.

name: Sticky Notes
look: Bright notes, marker doodles and pinned ideas arranged on a desk or wall.
motionRules: Notes peel, slide and pin into place; doodles draw on with small handmade bounces.
promptTemplate: Top-down creative planning board with layered sticky notes, paper scraps and simple marker doodles, warm natural desk light, tidy visual hierarchy, tactile shadows, blank notes with no generated text.

name: Magazine Cutout
look: Bold editorial photo collage with torn edges, oversized shapes and print texture.
motionRules: Cutouts snap and slide in with layered parallax; torn masks wipe between beats.
promptTemplate: Premium magazine cutout collage, editorial photography fragments, torn paper edges, bold geometric color blocks, offset print texture, high-fashion art direction, clean negative space, no generated text.

name: Paper Collage
look: Hand-cut documentary collage with aged newsprint, archival maps, halftone cutouts, tape, stamps, thread and layered paper shadows.
motionRules: Posterize to 12fps. Build back-to-front with rigid-paper slide-ins, stepped 2–3 frame holds, stamped landings and shallow parallax. Camera locked; then hold with grain and shadow breathing.
promptTemplate: Scissor-cut documentary paper collage on aged newsprint and archival map stock, monochrome halftone cutouts with ragged white edges, tape, typewriter slips, rubber stamps, red thread and brass pins, matte print grain, clean editorial layout, no unrequested text.

name: Your Face
look: The user's uploaded talking-head video enhanced with captions and supporting clips.
motionRules: Preserve the source performance. Add phrase-synced lower-third captions, restrained full-frame supporting cutaways and smooth returns to the presenter.
promptTemplate: Use the supplied presenter footage as the visual anchor. Supporting imagery must match the spoken point, preserve presenter audio, and contain no generated captions or text.
